SessionStart.command: sh -c 'd="$PWD"; p=""; while :; do c="$d/.github/agent-workflow/scripts/workflow_hook.py"; if [ -f "$c" ]; then p="$(cd "$(dirname "$c")" && pwd)/$(basename "$c")"; break; fi; [ "$d" = / ] && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -z "$p" ]; then c="$HOME/.copilot/agent-workflow/scripts/workflow_hook.py"; [ -f "$c" ] && p="$(cd "$(dirname "$c")" && pwd)/$(basename "$c")"; fi; [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "Agent Workflow hook script not found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p"'
SessionStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=(Get-Location).Path;$s=$null;while($true){$c=Join-Path $d '.github\agent-workflow\scripts\workflow_hook.ps1';if(Test-Path $c){$s=(Resolve-Path $c).Path;break};$p=Split-Path -Parent $d;if((-not $p)-or($p -eq $d)){break};$d=$p};if(-not $s){$c=Join-Path $HOME '.copilot\agent-workflow\scripts\workflow_hook.ps1';if(Test-Path $c){$s=(Resolve-Path $c).Path}};if(-not $s){throw 'Agent Workflow hook script not found'};& $s"
